nodes.text: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) spreads through respiratory droplets, much like RSV and influenza. In the majority of cases HMPV is a mild illness but in some cases, HMPV may cause more severe illness such as bronchitis, bronchiolitis, or pneumonia. https://t.co/yt3kKjhD6G

Remember to always practice good, stay home when sick, and protect vulnerable individuals to help reduce the spread of HMPV and other respiratory illnesses.
